convert.title: Share "{{vault}}" with other people?
convert.body: This turns your private vault into a team vault. Everything already in it moves across, so the people you add see it too.
convert.offlineWarning: Opens only while Voltius can reach the sync server — no offline access.
convert.keyCustody: Everyone you add gets a copy of its key. Removing them later doesn't take it back.
convert.change: You can make it private again later — that removes everyone's access, but not the copies they already have.

invite.title: Invite member
invite.seatsScope: Counted across every team you own, not just this one.
invite.seatsTrialClamp: Your trial caps you at {{cap}} seats until it ends, of the {{purchased}} you bought.
invite.handleRule: Only custom handles match on part of a name. For a generated handle like rapid-violet-8884, type it in full or use their email.
invite.seatsUnknown: Seat count unavailable — check your connection to the sync server
invite.selectRoleHint: Select at least one role before inviting

roleBlurb.manager: Managers can invite people, change roles and manage links.
roleBlurb.editor: Editors can add and change hosts, keys and snippets in this vault.
roleBlurb.member: Members can use everything in this vault but not change it.
roleBlurb.connect-only: Connect-only people can open connections but never see the credentials behind them.

error.cannotRemoveOwnerRole: Cannot remove the owner role from the team owner
error.convertFailed: Could not turn {{vault}} into a team vault — {{reason}}
error.serverUnreachable: the sync server could not be reached
error.memberHasNoPublicKey: They haven't published a key yet — ask them to sign in once.
error.notAKeyHolder: You don't hold this vault's key, so you can't grant it.

contextMenu.noInvitableSessions: No session can take this invite

empty.noVaultDesc: Select a vault in the sidebar to manage its members.
empty.signInToInvite: Sign in to invite teammates to this vault.

people.awaitingKey: Waiting for a key — they cannot open the vault yet
people.inviteLinkCopied: Invite link copied — it opens their invitation in Voltius.

cta.signInTitle: Sign in to use team features
cta.signInDesc: Members, invites, and shared vault access require a cloud account before you can upgrade or manage a team.
cta.signInBtn: Sign in or create cloud account →
cta.upgradeDesc: Invite members, assign roles, and share credentials securely with your team.

joinLinks.explainer: Anyone with the link joins this vault in the role you pick. The link never carries the vault's key — that arrives separately, once someone who already has it is online.
joinLinks.shownOnce: A link is shown once, when you create it. Nothing can show it again.
joinLinks.secretNotRecoverable: Link no longer viewable — revoke it and make a new one.

error.revokedOrExpired: This link has been revoked or has expired.
error.exhausted: This link has been used up.
error.seatLimit: This team has no seat free. Ask whoever sent the link to add one.
error.noPublicKey: Your device hasn't published a key yet. Sign in once, then open the link again.

confirm.title: Join {{team}}?
confirm.body: This link adds you to {{team}} as {{role}}.
confirm.keyFollowsLater: You'll join straight away, but the vault stays locked until someone who already has its key is online.
confirm.failed: Couldn't join — the link may have been revoked.

offboarding.pointAccessEnds: Their access to this vault's hosts, keys and snippets ends immediately, on every device.
offboarding.pointLocalWipe: The vault's contents are deleted from their devices, including saved passwords and private keys.
offboarding.pointAlreadySeen: They keep anything they already saw. Rotate credentials they had access to.
offboarding.pointSessions: They are dropped from any shared terminal session they had joined.
offboarding.leavePointAccessEnds: You lose access to this vault's hosts, keys and snippets on every device.
offboarding.leavePointLocalWipe: Its contents are deleted from this device, including saved passwords and private keys.
offboarding.leavePointIrreversible: You cannot rejoin without a new invitation.
